exposure.needed: which tooling or scripts list Kubernetes events using a field-selector on regardingObject that references the Pod

consequence.statement: Event-listing queries that use a field-selector on regardingObject targeting the Pod will no longer return the Pod restart events, because those events now carry the Kafka resource as the regardingObject; the selector must be updated to the Kafka resource.
consequence.remediation: Update any field-selector used for listing events to specify the Kafka resource as the regardingObject instead of the Pod.

assertion.statement: In Strimzi 0.46.0, Kubernetes events for Pod restarts no longer have the Pod as the regardingObject but the Kafka resource instead, so any event-listing query using regardingObject as a field-selector must be updated to select the Kafka resource.
